# Adversarial MNIST compared with random noise

- Source: Christian Szegedy, Wojciech Zaremba, Ilya Sutskever, Joan Bruna,
  Dumitru Erhan, Ian Goodfellow, and Rob Fergus,
  *Intriguing properties of neural networks* (2014).
- PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1312.6199.
- Figure 7, page 7: all three panels and their original subcaptions.
  Odd columns contain originals; even columns contain modified images.
  Panels (a) and (b) target a linear classifier and a sigmoid network,
  respectively; panel (c) uses Gaussian noise.
- Downloaded and extracted 2026-10-19. Crop in PDF points, measured from the
  upper-left corner of the 612-by-792-point source page: (130, 85, 482, 193).
- The PDF crop retains the original images and subcaptions without retouching;
  the original main caption is omitted.
